summary: In Ironforge, Laris Geardawdle seeks ooze samples from Felwood for his studies. He hopes to learn why the Royal Apothecary Society gathers them and what interests the Undercity's alchemists.

sections.title: A Peculiar Obsession
sections.body: Laris Geardawdle studies oozes with the Explorers' League. Most of its scholars seek titan relics or dwarven genealogies, but these living puddles resist ordinary classification. They appear in wetlands, cursed woods, and damp ruins. Laris has seen Forsaken apothecaries collecting slime across Lordaeron, and wants to know what draws them to it.

sections.title: The Primordial Secretion
sections.body: Laris believes oozes may be primordial secretions tied to Azeroth's creation. He thinks they are neither vermin nor magical byproducts. To test his theory, you travel across the ocean to Felwood's blighted canopy. There, you gather Cursed and Tainted Oozes in specially made jars.

sections.title: Proving Gnomish Worth
sections.body: For Laris and many displaced gnomes, these studies carry personal weight. Since Gnomeregan fell to troggs and radiation, thousands have taken refuge in Ironforge's Great Forge. A discovery for the Explorers' League could answer dwarven skeptics. It could show that welcoming gnomes into the mountain city has become an enduring asset to Alliance science.

faq.answer: Laris Geardawdle is a gnomish researcher and scholar in Ironforge. He works with the Explorers' League to study the biological origins of oozes and slimes across Azeroth.

faq.q: Why does Laris care so much about ooze?
faq.answer: Laris suspects oozes are primordial secretions tied to Azeroth's origins. The Royal Apothecary Society's eager collection of slime samples has made him determined to learn their secret properties before the Horde does.

faq.q: Where do you gather the ooze samples?
faq.answer: You gather samples from Cursed Oozes and Tainted Oozes in Felwood's corrupted forests in northern Kalimdor. You use empty glass containers Laris provides.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken collecting oozes?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society experiments with toxins, blights, and biological horrors to advance Forsaken alchemy. Its interest in raw oozes suggests they may contain virulent or mutagenic compounds.

faq.q: How does this quest connect to the fall of Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: After Gnomeregan was lost to troggs and radiation, Laris felt the pressure of life as a refugee in Ironforge. He hopes a major scientific triumph for the Explorers' League will prove that giving gnomes refuge was worthwhile to their dwarven hosts.

faq.q: What happens after you deliver the samples?
faq.answer: Laris begins testing the specimens in his Ironforge laboratory setup. He develops his theories about ooze taxonomy and elemental origins.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see Laris's drive to rebuild gnomish pride and reputation after Gnomeregan's heartbreaking loss.
As a dwarf, you may favor stone and metal over gelatinous sludge. The Explorers' League benefits from Laris's unusual drive.
As an Alliance member, you can learn from the Royal Apothecary Society's gathering habits about the sinister brews the Undercity may be concocting.
